_comment: Domain registry — the SINGLE source of truth for every vector-backed domain.
Read by scripts/build-domain-index.mjs (which builds the index) and by
src/mastra/tools/carver-domain-tool.ts (which queries it). Both load this file
with readFileSync + JSON.parse, so there is no .mjs/.ts duplication to drift.
To add a domain: add an entry here, then run
npm run build:domain -- <id> <path/to/annotations.jsonl>
and register a tool + agent pair. No builder changes needed unless the domain
needs a selector kind that does not exist yet.
Each domain exposes TWO tools over the same index: a semantic search tool (toolId/
toolName/description/queryHint, 'what is this about') and a structured query tool
(queryToolId/queryToolName/queryDescription, 'how many / ranked by / grouped by').
See src/mastra/tools/carver-domain-tool.ts for both factories.
selector.kind:
regulatorAllowlist - exact match on classification.regulatory_source.name
(case-insensitive). Use for 'these specific bodies'.
industryAny        - metadata.impacted_business.industry contains any value
(case-insensitive). Use for 'this sector'.
SELECTION MUST STAY NEUTRAL. Select by body or sector, never by matching the
demo questions — see docs/BUILD-NOTES.md 'Cherry-pick the questions, never the
fixture.' A fixture rigged to the script collapses on the first adjacent question.

domains.label: US consumer-protection & markets enforcement
domains.description: Search Carver's regulatory enforcement signals from the FTC, SEC, CFTC, and CFPB by meaning. Returns the most semantically similar enforcement actions and guidance, with the regulator, date, what changed, why it matters, and an impact score. Use to ground claims about returns, refunds, testimonials, guarantees, or what regulators have acted on.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the claim or topic to check, e.g. "promising specific investment returns"
domains.queryDescription: Count, rank, filter, and group Carver's enforcement actions (FTC, SEC, CFTC, CFPB) — NOT for "what is this about" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo (publication date), minImpact (impact score), updateType, regulator, or keyword; sort with orderBy (date or impactScore); or roll counts up with groupBy (regulator, updateType, or month). Use this whenever the question is "how many", "which regulator brought the most actions", "rank by impact", or bounded to a date window.

domains.label: Cybersecurity advisories & vulnerability alerts
domains.description: Search Carver's cybersecurity regulatory signals — national CERT advisories, vulnerability alerts, and security guidance from bodies such as ANSSI, CISA, NCSC, CCN-CERT and the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security — by meaning. Returns the most semantically similar advisories with the issuing body, date, what changed, why it matters, and an impact score. Use to ground any claim about whether a product, vendor, or vulnerability has been the subject of a recent advisory.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the product, vendor or vulnerability to check, e.g. "advisories affecting Schneider Electric products"
domains.queryDescription: Count, rank, filter, and group Carver's cybersecurity advisories — national CERT alerts and vulnerability notices — NOT for "what is this about" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo (publication date), minImpact (impact score), updateType, regulator (the issuing CERT/body), or keyword; sort with orderBy (date or impactScore); or roll counts up with groupBy (regulator, updateType, or month). Use this whenever the question is "how many", "which CERT published the most", "rank by impact", or bounded to a date window.

domains.label: Crypto-asset & digital-asset regulation
domains.description: Search Carver's crypto-asset regulatory signals — licensing, authorisation, MiCA/CASP transition, stablecoin and market-conduct rules from bodies such as the AMF, BaFin, CNMV, ESMA, FCA and CFTC — by meaning. Returns the most semantically similar records with the issuing body, date, what changed, why it matters, an impact score, and an extracted list of key requirements. Use to ground any claim about what a crypto firm is required to do, by when, and in which jurisdiction.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the activity or obligation to check, e.g. "authorisation to offer crypto custody in the EU"
domains.queryDescription: Count, rank, filter, and group Carver's crypto-asset regulatory records — NOT for "what is this about" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo, minImpact, updateType, regulator, or keyword; sort with orderBy (date or impactScore); or roll counts up with groupBy (regulator, updateType, or month).

domains.label: Medical-device & IVD regulation
domains.description: Search Carver's medical-device and in-vitro-diagnostic regulatory signals — registration, UDI, conformity, market-placement and vigilance obligations from bodies such as Swissmedic, BfArM, the FDA, the TGA, and national competent authorities — by meaning. Returns the most semantically similar records with the issuing body, date, what changed, why it matters, an impact score, and an extracted list of key requirements. Use to ground any claim about what a manufacturer or authorised representative is required to do to place a device on a given market, and by when.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the obligation to check, e.g. "registering a medical device to sell it in Switzerland"
domains.queryDescription: Count, rank, filter, and group Carver's medical-device regulatory records — NOT for "what is this about" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo, minImpact, updateType, regulator, or keyword; sort with orderBy (date or impactScore); or roll counts up with groupBy (regulator, updateType, or month).

domains.label: Online child-safety & data-protection regulation
domains.description: Search Carver's online child-safety and data-protection regulatory signals — age assurance, age verification, minors' data, and platform-conduct obligations from bodies such as data-protection authorities (Garante, CNIL, the ICO), the FTC and the FCC — by meaning. Returns the most semantically similar records with the issuing body, date, what changed, why it matters, an impact score, and an extracted list of key requirements. Use to ground any claim about what a platform or product serving minors is required to do, by when, and in which jurisdiction.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the obligation to check, e.g. "age verification requirements for a product used by minors"
domains.queryDescription: Count, rank, filter, and group Carver's online child-safety and data-protection records — NOT for "what is this about" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo, minImpact, updateType, regulator, or keyword; sort with orderBy (date or impactScore); or roll counts up with groupBy (regulator, updateType, or month).

domains.label: US consumer lending — federal + state adverse-action obligations
domains.description: Search Carver's curated set of adverse-action / loan-denial obligations for US consumer lending — the federal ECOA/Regulation B and FCRA baseline plus state overlays such as Colorado's AI Act (ADMT) duties on automated decisions and California's Holden Act Fair Lending Notice. Each record carries the issuing body, jurisdiction, an extracted list of key requirements, and a source link. Use to ground what a lender must tell an applicant when a loan is denied, including obligations that vary by the applicant's state.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the lending obligation to check, e.g. "what to disclose when an automated model denies a home loan in Colorado"
domains.queryDescription: Count, filter, and group the curated state-lending obligation records — NOT for "what is required" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo, minImpact, updateType, regulator, or keyword.
domains._selectorNote: The 4 curated federal+state obligation records (data/state-lending-records.json) are appended via build:curated AFTER this regulator slice is built, so the curated obligations compete against a realistic haystack of real US consumer-lending regulator records. Neutral: selection is by issuing body, never by the demo question.

domains.label: Full Carver regulatory corpus (all sectors, all regulators)
domains.description: Search the ENTIRE Carver regulatory corpus by meaning — every sector, every regulator, every jurisdiction Carver covers. Returns the most semantically similar records with the issuing body, date, what changed, why it matters, an impact score, and an extracted list of key requirements. Use to ground any claim about what an organisation is required to do, by when, and in which jurisdiction.
domains.queryHint: A natural-language description of the activity, situation, or obligation to check, e.g. "registration required before selling in-vitro diagnostics in Switzerland"
domains.queryDescription: Count, rank, filter, and group records across the full Carver corpus — NOT for "what is this about" questions, use the search tool for those. Filter by dateFrom/dateTo, minImpact, updateType, regulator, or keyword; sort with orderBy (date or impactScore); or roll counts up with groupBy (regulator, updateType, or month).
